Wrist-Wrap Fit

The original strap mesh is a static display drape (product-shot pose), not a wearable rig — so it's replaced here with a procedural band that wraps a real wrist cylinder, using your case/dial/hands geometry as-is.

Band axis, arm axis and case normal are all derived at runtime from the mesh's own geometry (PCA on the strap point cloud + case bounding-box orientation) — no manual axis was hand-picked for this specific model.
